definition: Artificial Intelligence of Things (AIoT) is the combination of artificial intelligence (AI) technologies with the Internet of things (IoT) infrastructure to create systems capable of sensing, learning, and acting on data without continuous human intervention.
details: While IoT focuses on connectivity and sensor data collection, AI enables IoT devices to analyse data in real time and produce actionable outputs, including automated decisions at the edge.
story: Think of a historian sorting through boxes of letters, building a picture of an era one sentence at a time. Every machine is shaped by what it was shown, so someone has to choose that material with care. The examples a machine reads become the world it believes in. The words a model reads become the world it believes in. And that is Artificial intelligence of things — the unglamorous work everything else stands on.
